sources.entry: Tempo - Replace the Git CLI with a clear UI and AI assist.

summary.one_liner: Changes (formerly Tempo) is an open-source macOS GUI Git client built with SwiftUI and AppKit that replaces common Git CLI commands with a Mac-native interface and uses Apple Intelligence for commit message and stash summary generation.
summary.what_it_does: The app provides a graphical interface for everyday Git work on Mac, covering commit (amend, revert, checkout, reusable commit message snippets), staging by hunk, and branch operations (push, pull, merge, create, filter). It also handles tags (create and push, delete, filter) and stashes (apply, with summary generation). Commit search can filter by commit message, changed content (added/removed), author, and revision range such as main.. or v1.0.0...v2.0.0. Commit message generation and stash summaries use Apple Intelligence. The README says the UI uses Apple's Liquid Glass styling.
use_cases: Use a graphical Git client instead of the command line on Mac
Stage individual hunks of changes before committing
Generate commit messages with Apple Intelligence
Search commit history by author, message, or changed text
Create, push, and delete Git tags
Manage branches with push, pull, and merge from a GUI
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the repository's releases page
Run the app (requires macOS 26.0 or later for v2.0+, or macOS 14.6 or later for v1.18 and below)
notable: Commit message generation and stash summaries powered by Apple Intelligence
Stage by hunk for fine-grained commits
Commit search by changed content and revision range
Styled with Apple's Liquid Glass design
Older v1.x builds ship under the former name Tempo.app
caveats: Requires macOS 26.0 or later for v2.0+; v1.18 and below need macOS 14.6 or later
Apple Intelligence features depend on Apple Intelligence support on the Mac
Install instructions cover only downloading a release; no build-from-source steps are given
